ety.hint: The sun 日 rising over a city 京; 京 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 京 (capital) as the sound. It first meant sunlight, then what the light shows: scenery, a view, circumstances.
A person with long hair (a form related to 美, beautiful) plus 攵 (hand with tool), combing out fine hairs: tiny, minute; 彳 (step) was added later. The hair person is now drawn as 山 over 兀.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 我 (I) as the sound: first a person tilting, then 'suddenly'; now used to write Russia.

逐.def: to pursue; to expel; step by step

origin.says: 辶 (walking) + 豕 (pig): going after a pig, to chase. Some take 豕 as a sound part instead.

逐.name: chase

origin.says: A picture of a kneeling person combing their hair with both hands: smooth, obedient, 'to conform, be like'; 口 (mouth) was added later. The hair became 艹 (grass) and a hand became 𠂇, so the top now looks like 右 (right).

卫.def: to guard, to protect, to defend

origin.says: From 衛: feet walking around a spot inside 行 (crossroads), with 韋 (go around) as the sound: patrolling to guard. 卫 comes from a cursive shorthand.

卫.name: guard

藏.def: to conceal, to hide; to hoard, to store

origin.says: 艹 (grass, for covering) for the meaning plus 臧 (good) as the sound: to hide away, to store.

藏.name: hide away

竟.def: finally, after all, at last; indeed; unexpected

ety.hint: A person 儿 finishing a musical piece 音

origin.says: Origin unclear. One old reading: 音 (music) plus 儿 (person), the end of a piece of music, hence 'to finish, at last'. Another sees a chisel over a person, a punishment mark.

竟.name: after all

倒.def: to collapse, to fall over; to lie down

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 到 (arrive) as the sound: a person falling over, hence to collapse; also upside down.

倒.name: topple

追.def: to pursue, to chase after; to expel

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 𠂤 (heap) as the sound: moving after someone, to chase.

追.name: pursue

抓.def: to clutch, to grab, to seize

ety.hint: A hand 扌 with claws 爪; 爪 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 爪 (claw) as the sound and a hint: to seize with the fingers like a claw, to grab, to scratch.

抓.name: grab

origin.says: A drawing of a pestle for pounding grain (now 杵 (pestle)). It was borrowed for the seventh earthly branch, which marks the midday hours, hence noon.
The right hand, first written 又 (hand); a 口 (mouth) was added in bronze inscriptions only to tell it apart from 又. The hand is now written 𠂇.

寻.def: to seek; to search for, to look for; ancient

origin.says: Two outstretched hands, now 彐 (hand) and 寸 (hand), measuring an arm span, then 'to search'. Simplified from 尋 by dropping its 工 (work) and 口 (mouth).

寻.name: search

搞.def: to do, to fix, to make, to settle

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 高 (tall) as the sound: to do with the hands, to fix or get something done.

搞.name: do it

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 奥 (deep inner corner) as the sound: an inlet, a bay; also short for Macau and Australia.
A variant of 祕: 示 (altar) for the meaning plus 必 (must) as the sound, secret rites. The altar part was replaced by 禾 (grain), so the modern form reads grain + sound.

ety.hint: A tiger 虍 striking fear into the heart 心

origin.says: From 慮: 思 (think) for the meaning plus 虍 (tiger head) as the sound, to think over, to worry. Simplification dropped the 田 of 思, leaving 心 (heart).
氵 (water) plus 昷, first a person bathing in a basin of warm water; water was added later. Simplified from 溫, whose inner part was written 日 over 皿 (basin).

吸.def: to inhale, to suck in; to absorb; to attract

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 及 (reach, grab) as the sound: to draw in through the mouth, to inhale or suck; the sense of grabbing may also help.

吸.name: inhale

补.def: to fix, to mend, to patch, to restore

origin.says: Simplified from 補: 衤 (clothes) for the meaning plus 甫 as the sound: to patch clothes, to mend. The sound part 甫 was replaced by the simpler 卜 (divine).

补.name: patch

ety.hint: A rock 口 at the base of a cliff 厂

origin.says: One reading sees a stone chime (a hanging stone played as a bell), with 口 added as decoration; another sees a rock 口 at the foot of a cliff 厂. Either way: stone.

石.name: stone
石.in: 确研破础码碍硬碰矿碎磨硕砸砍碳碑碗拓岩磅砖碌磁磕碱碟砌硝硫砾碧砂硅砚矾泵砰碘磊碾礁磷蘑

ety.hint: Two eyes shut 林 at night 夕

origin.says: Traditional 夢 began as a picture of a person lying on a bed with the eye stressed, dreaming; 夕 (evening) was added later. The simplified form keeps 夕 and writes the top as 林 (woods).

跑.def: to run, to flee, to escape

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound: to run.

跑.name: run

恶.def: bad, evil, wicked; to hate, to loathe; foul, nauseating

origin.says: Simplified from 惡: 亞 (second) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: a bad heart, evil, and to hate; 亞 became 亚. It also replaces 噁 (nauseating).

恶.name: evil

ety.hint: Cutting 刂 a piece of jade 王 in two, symbolizing two classes

origin.says: Two pieces of jade, 王 (jade) on each side, with a knife 刂 (knife) between them: cutting jade tallies to hand out. 'Divide' became division, group, class, shift.

某.def: some, someone; a certain thing or person

ety.hint: The sweet 甘 fruit of a certain tree 木

origin.says: 甘 (sweet) above 木 (tree): a tree with sweet fruit, the plum (now written 梅). Borrowed for 'a certain, some'.

某.name: a certain

输.def: to carry, to haul, to transport

origin.says: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: to haul goods by cart; later also to give up, to lose. Simplified from 輸 (車 → 车).

输.name: haul cart

origin.says: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 化 (change) as the sound: valuables that change hands, goods. Simplified from 貨 (貝 → 贝).

ety.hint: A card squeezed between 上 and 下

origin.says: 上 (up) and 下 (down) fused, sharing their horizontal stroke: something stuck between above and below, to block. Used for its sound for 'card'.

抗.def: to defy, to fight, to resist

ety.hint: Fighting 亢 with bare hands 扌; 亢 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 亢 (high) as the sound: to raise the hand against, to resist.

抗.name: resist

址.def: location, site; the foundation of a house

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 止 (foot, stop) as the sound: the ground a house stands on, a site.

址.name: site

培.def: to cultivate, to farm; to shore up

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 咅 (spit) as the sound: banking up soil around plants, 'to cultivate'.

培.name: cultivate

ety.hint: Liquid 氵 gas 气; 气 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 气 (air) as the sound, which also hints at the meaning: water turned into air, steam.

综.def: to sum up; to arrange threads for weaving

origin.says: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 宗 (clan) as the sound: the loom device gathering the warp threads, hence 'to sum up, synthesise'. Simplified from 綜 (the silk side became 纟).

综.name: sum up

ety.hint: Simplified form of 婦; a woman 女 with a broom 彐

origin.says: Simplified from 婦: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 帚 (broom) as the sound, and perhaps the meaning too, a woman with a broom. The simplified form keeps only 彐, the top of 帚.

检.def: to check, to examine, to inspect

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: first a wooden label or seal on documents, then to check. Simplified from 檢 by shortening 僉 to 佥.

检.name: check up

融.def: to melt, to fuse; to blend, to harmonize

origin.says: 鬲 (cooking cauldron) for the meaning plus 蟲 (insects), cut down to 虫 (worm), as the sound: steam rising from a cauldron, hence to melt and to blend.

融.name: melt

ety.hint: Jade 玉 kept in one's house 宀

origin.says: Simplified from 寶: 宀 (house) holding 玉 (jade) and 貝 (shells), with 缶 (jar) added as the sound. The simplified form keeps only 宀 + 玉, an old variant.

附.def: nearby; to adhere to, to attach; to rely on

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 付 (hand over) as the sound: a small mound lying against a larger one, hence 'to attach, to be close to'.

附.name: attach

央.def: central; to beg; to run out

origin.says: Possibly a drawing of a person 大 (big man) with a yoke or cangue around the neck; the word for 'middle' is a borrowing of its sound. One reading sees a person inside a frame instead.

央.name: center

ety.hint: To skillfully wield 帀 a knife 㠯

origin.says: Simplified from 飯: 食 (food) for the meaning plus 反 (reverse) as the sound: cooked rice, a meal. 食 became 饣.

督.def: to supervise, to oversee, to direct

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 叔 (uncle) as the sound: to look over with the eyes, to oversee, to supervise.

督.name: oversee

origin.says: Simplified from 幣: 敝 (worn) as the sound plus 巾 (cloth) for the meaning: silk given as a gift, later money. The simplified form replaces 敝 with one stroke 丿.
Simplified from 穩: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 㥯 (careful) as the sound, grain gathered safely, hence stable. As in 隐 (hide), 㥯 was turned into a shape like 急 (urgent).

药.def: drugs, medicine; the leaf of the Dahurian angelica plant

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 约 (agreement) as the sound: herbal medicine. It replaced 藥, whose sound part was 樂 (music); 葯 was an unrelated existing character taken over for it.

药.name: medicine

既.def: already, since, then; both; de facto

ety.hint: A person 旡 turning away from food 皀; compare 即

origin.says: A bowl of food on the left and 旡 (a kneeling person turning the head away) on the right: done eating, hence 'already'.

既.name: done eating

访.def: to visit; to inquire, to ask

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: to ask about, then to visit. Simplified from 訪, with 言 in its short form 讠.

访.name: visit

origin.says: 矢 (arrow) for the meaning plus 豆 (bean) as the sound: arrows served as a short measuring stick, hence short.

ety.hint: A person 大 riding a horse 可

origin.says: 大 (big) for the meaning plus 可 (can) as the sound: something out of the ordinary, strange. One source instead reads it as a person astride a horse.

ety.hint: A home 广 with a servant 隶

origin.says: 庚 (threshing tool) plus 米 (rice) for grain husks, chaff (now written 糠); borrowed for health and peace. The bottom now looks like 隶 (seize), but is unrelated to it.

劳.def: to labor, to toil; to do manual work

ety.hint: A man lifting 力 a load 冖 of grass 艹

origin.says: Traditional 勞: a shortened sound part (two 火 (fire) over 冖 (cover)) plus 力 (strength) for the meaning: to toil. The simplified form writes the two fires as 艹. One source calls the origin unclear.

劳.name: toil

骗.def: to cheat, to defraud, to swindle

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 扁 (flat) as the sound: first to swing a leg over a horse, later to cheat and swindle. Simplified from 騙 (馬 → 马).

骗.name: swindle

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 未 (not yet) as the sound: what the mouth senses, taste, flavour.

亡.def: death, destruction; to lose; to perish

ety.hint: A man 人 in a coffin; see 亾

origin.says: One reading: a knife blade with its sharp tip marked (the original of 芒, point); another sees a person hidden in a corner. Borrowed early for 'not have, lose', hence to flee, perish.

亡.name: perish
亡.in: 望赢忙忘谎荒盲慌芒氓妄茫

退.def: to retreat, to step back, to withdraw

origin.says: In oracle bones a food vessel plus a downward foot: leaving the table after eating, so withdrawing. A walking sign, now 辶 (walk), was added; the vessel later turned into the unrelated 艮.

退.name: retreat

阳.def: the male principle; bright, sunny; clear, lit, open

ety.hint: The place 阝 of the sun 日; compare 阴

origin.says: From 陽: 阜 (hill) for the meaning plus 昜 (sunshine) as the sound, the sunny side of a hill. The simplified form replaces 昜 with 日 (sun), an old variant.

阳.name: sunny side

origin.says: Traditional 勝: 力 (strength) for the meaning plus 朕 (I, the ruler) as the sound: to be equal to, win. The simplified form took over 胜, an old character (月 flesh + 生 sound) for raw meat smell, as it sounded alike.
Simplified from 禮 (rite): 礻 (altar) for the meaning plus 豊 (ritual vessel) as the sound, rites at the altar. The simple form is an old variant that replaced 豊 with the bare hook 乚.

恐.def: fearful, apprehensive; to fear, to dread

origin.says: 巩 (secure) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: a heart afraid, to fear. In the oldest dictionary the sound part was a variant of 巩 (secure).

恐.name: dread

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 召 (to summon) as the sound: to tie threads together, to connect, hence to introduce people. Simplified from 紹, only the silk side was shortened.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 亥 (twelfth earthly branch) as the sound. It named a kind of tree; the senses 'stone of a fruit, kernel, core' (and now 'atom, nucleus') came later.

Disputed: one reading is 屮 (sprout) for the meaning plus 毐 (a wicked man) as the sound, a poisonous plant; another is a woman with a feathered headdress, borrowed for 'poison'. The modern top 龶 and bottom 母 (mother) are just shapes.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: first a sound of assent or a bird's cry, borrowed for 'only'.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 既 (already) as the sound: a stick used to level grain in a measure. From 'level off' came 'general, approximate'.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 垂 (droop) as the sound: eyelids drooping, to sleep; the sense of hanging down may also help.

挥.def: to direct; to squander; to wave; to wipe away

ety.hint: To direct an army 军 by hand 扌

origin.says: From 揮: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 軍 (army) as the sound: to wave, brandish, command. 軍 was shortened to 军.

挥.name: wave

ety.hint: A metal 钅 pin 十

origin.says: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 十 (ten) as the sound: a needle. Simplified from 針, with 金 written 钅.

谓.def: to call, to say, to tell; name, title; meaning

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 胃 (stomach) as the sound: to say, to call. Simplified from 謂 (言 → 讠).

谓.name: call it

origin.says: A drawing of a cord wound turn after turn around a stick or weapon handle: orderly sequence. From 'order of rank' it came to mean 'younger brother'.

登.def: to rise, to mount, to board, to climb

origin.says: 癶 (two feet) above 豆 (a raised vessel or step): feet going up onto something, to climb or mount. Early forms also had two hands at the bottom, later dropped; some sources read 豆 (bean) as the sound instead.

登.name: climb up

献.def: to offer, to present; to show, to display

origin.says: Simplified from 獻: 鬳 (steamer pot) as the sound plus 犬 (dog), a dog offered in sacrifice: to offer, to present. The simple form replaced 鬳 with 南 (south).

献.name: offer up

ety.hint: Two men, one alive 土 and one dead 干; the living one is lucky

origin.says: Origin disputed: one reading sees 夭 (early death) above 屰 (reverse), escaping disaster, lucky; another, a dog and a sheep as bringers of luck. The modern shape is 土 (earth) over 𢆉.

急.def: anxious, worried; hasty, quick; pressing, urgent

origin.says: Originally 及 (to reach) as the sound over 心 (heart) for the meaning: a heart pressed, anxious, in a hurry. The top 及 later changed shape and now looks like 刍 (fodder).

急.name: urgent

迎.def: to welcome, to receive, to greet

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 卬 (looking up) as the sound: to go out to meet someone, to welcome.

迎.name: welcome

origin.says: 弓 (bow) for the meaning plus 單 (single) as the sound: to shoot pellets from a bow, then a pellet or bullet, and to pluck strings. Simplified from 彈 with 单.

含.def: to hold in the mouth; to contain; to cherish

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 今 (now) as the sound: to hold in the mouth, then to contain.

含.name: hold in mouth

阅.def: to examine, to inspect; to read, to review

origin.says: Simplified from 閱: 門 (gate) for the meaning plus 兌 as the sound: to count people passing a gate, to inspect; hence to read. 門 is written 门 and 兌 兑.

阅.name: read through

怀.def: bosom, breast; to carry in one's bosom

origin.says: Simplified from 懷: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 褱 (bosom) as the sound, which was replaced by 不 (not). It first meant to long for; also the bosom, to hold in one's arms.

怀.name: bosom

板.def: board, plank; plate, slab; unnatural, stiff

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 反 (reverse) as the sound: a board, a plank. Simplification also uses it for 闆 (boss).

板.name: plank

ety.hint: A street vendor talks 口 incessantly, like a bird 隹

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning, calling out wares, plus the sound part 雔 (pair of birds), shortened to a single 隹 (bird): to sell.
